entities.summary: Curtis John Guillory, S.V.D. is an American prelate of the Catholic Church and member of the Society of the Divine Word. Guillory served as bishop of Beaumont in Texas from 2000 to 2020. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Diocese of Galveston–Houston in Texas from 1988 to 2000, the first Black Catholic bishop in Texas history.
